section_en: 2. API Specification / API Inventory and Responsibilities / Authentication Profiles
quote_en: **API-R-001 — Confirmed:** All inventory entries inherit the applicable authentication profile. Public resource authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, sensitivity, document ACL, action and segregation of duties.
